steps.text: Rhodes Island Command Center

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: I'm sorry. I shouldn't have brought her back.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Help me understand what happened.

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: As I stated in the report, she was unconscious near the safe house, barely clinging to life. She was covered in dust and sand, looking just like a desert Catastrophe victim.

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: I wanted to give her a sip of water. A bit of the old habit came out.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: There's nothing wrong with the compassion to help those in need, as long as you can handle the responsibilities that come with it.

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: I'll admit, I did not fully consider who she might be.

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: I gave her a little salt water and left her in the shade near the village.

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: The next time I saw her, she was on the aircraft.

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: Obviously, she followed me.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And you said you didn't notice anything at the time, correct?

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: I performed a comprehensive cabin inspection, and didn't see anything out of the ordinary.

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: She suddenly appeared in the middle of the journey, and I can't even confirm that she had been hiding inside the aircraft.

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: If not for her poor physical condition at the time, she might've even hit me with that attack.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: According to our analyses, she possesses some form of invisibility-type Originium Arts. If you can provide any further details, we'll have an easier time handling her.

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: I'm sorry, Dr. Kal'tsit. I honestly don't have anything else to offer.

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: She didn't even leave footprints in the sand.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That could also be useful information.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Can you think of any reasons she might've had for attacking you?

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: I'm thinking it might've been an old grudge, or a simple misunderstanding. It might've even been a stress response after crossing the desert.

options: Or maybe it's because you saw her.

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: That's crossed my mind as well.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Rhodes Island will continue to investigate her, but some answers may have to come straight from the girl's mouth.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Just so you feel better, Stormeye, she hasn't hurt anyone since coming to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: She allowed us to examine her, but while we were administering an IV, she pulled the needle out and left Medical. She's been placed in a single dorm since then.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: From the data we've gotten back from her infection monitoring device, her life isn't in imminent danger.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: However, she refuses to communicate with us.

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Now then, the next matter is yours, {@nickname}.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We tried to identify the ID cards she had on her person, but most of them are older than her – remnants from a regional conflict decades ago.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: All we can tell from them is she has been active throughout most of Sargon. Beyond that, there's no deeper connection among those IDs.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The other angle of investigation arises from the weapon she was carrying. We can fairly conclusively say that her primary function mode is assassination.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: She carried several small and delicate devices with a level of craftsmanship unlikely to be self-made.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But, Rhodes Island has no way to trace the weapons and poisons. Our intelligence networks have come up completely blank.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Similarly, assassinations are not uncommon in Sargon, so we can't link her activities with any specific event.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Finally, judging from her behavior since coming in contact with Rhodes Island, it might be difficult to get any information directly from her.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: She has been awake for three days, but has continued to refuse the food and water we've provided.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If she's so fiercely loyal to her past, can we really reach a cooperative relationship with her?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ––These are things for you to decide, {@nickname}. If you have time, you can go see her.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: For Rhodes Island, she is an Infected first and foremost, and that has nothing to do with her past.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If she is willing to cooperate, then we can accept her.

steps.name: Person in a White Mask
steps.text: Same rules as always. Spin the bottle.

steps.name: Person in a White Mask
steps.text: Whoever the bottle points to takes the job.
Everyone quietly gathers in a circle. The bottle spins with no regard for who it chooses. They're all the same.
The mouth of the bottle stops in front of her. She takes the note from inside, and leaves the group.

steps.name: Person in a White Mask
steps.text: The orders are inside the bottle, on the slip of paper.
The group leader always repeats these words, as if tacitly acknowledging the presence of newcomers.
But she doesn't keep track of the comings and goings. Sometimes three or four show up. Other times, there might be as many as a dozen.
She reckons that the group leader probably doesn't keep track either, because the voice behind the white mask has changed as well.

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: Haah......

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: (That was a close one... I almost fell asleep again...)

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: (Nnh... What am I wearing? The texture feels so weird...)

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door A
steps.text: I haven't seen a Manticore in years! The girl won't come out?

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: (The observers are coming...)

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door B
steps.text: Please calm down, Dr. Warfarin. If you shackle her to... Err, invite her to your operating table, you might stir up some repressed psychological trauma in that child.

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door A
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door A
steps.text: Then what does Kal'tsit plan to do? We might have the most advanced medical technology, but we can't treat patients through a door.

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door B
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit said to give her some more time... If she doesn't want to open the door, we can't force her.

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door B
steps.text: Right, I found an old uniform jacket for her. There's no way she can wear whatever she had on before.

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door B
steps.text: She looked a lot more energetic after getting her out of those gritty, blood-soaked rags.

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door B
steps.text: Don't worry too much. Your subject... Err, I mean, your patient, should recover soon enough.

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: It's quiet again.

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: Are the observers gone?

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: They know... I'm an Infected.

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: They are waiting for me to give in... Using treatment as a bait... to trick me into giving in.

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: Ugh!

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: You can't touch it... Even if it's inside me, I can press down hard until it hurts, but I can't feel the Originium.

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: So, if they know I'm an Infected, they must know who I am.

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: Has my cover been blown? I failed to kill that soldier...

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: They're testing me... They want to know if I can still be used.

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: That would be great. It's been so, so long since I've gotten orders.

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: I will prove myself.

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: There's a strange restraint on my leg. It looks like tech that only a nomadic city would have.

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: There are soft beds here too... and no sand stuck between the cracks of the walls.

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: Just like living in Dreamland... Could I be in the same place as that Padishah?

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door A
steps.text: Excuse me, how are you doing? Are you still sleeping?

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door A
steps.text: I know... if you're starving, you can't eat a whole bunch of food in one sitting. So, I made some very light porridge for you.

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door A
steps.text: Still asleep, huh? Well, I'll slide it through the little window here.

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door B
steps.text: Oh hey there, Gummy. Are you in charge of breakfast today? I would've been out of bed at the crack of dawn, if I knew.

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door B
steps.text: Oh, did you come to visit the new girl too? I was gonna ask if she wanted to put together a manicure set with me, but she never showed up.

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door A
steps.text: The folks from Medical told me she needs to rest up, and that I shouldn't go bothering her.

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door B
steps.text: It's not like I'm going door to door selling stuff. I just wanted to see if she felt like getting some fresh air.

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door B
steps.text: I finally found someone who'd look great with blue nail polish. I'm not gonna let this opportunity slide by!

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door A
steps.text: Err, Utage... You don't need to get so fired up over that kind of stuff.

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: (They're calling each other by name... It doesn't seem scripted.)

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: (In other words, the ones who captured me... are enemies.)

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: (They confiscated my weapons... There's no sharp furniture here either.)

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: (They're getting ready to interrogate me, and... they don't plan on letting me escape before they do.)

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: (And a lot of people here have seen me... I'm already useless.)

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: (But it's okay. This was bound to happen one day.)

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door A
steps.text: Oh right, did she not touch the plates we brought her yesterday and the day before?

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door B
steps.text: Seems like it. Is she like those Vouivres who can just eat or not eat whenever they want?

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door A
steps.text: No clue... Isn't going hungry super sad though? Plus, all that food is going to waste.

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door A
steps.text: Well, whatever. Sounds like our new friend is still sleeping, so let's not bother her.

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: They're gone.

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: Did they really... say all those things so I could hear them?

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Doctor, I never knew you had the time to come to the operator dorms.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Whenever I pass by your office, I can tell you're totally swamped with operation materials and paperwork.

options: Kal'tsit suggested I come visit her when I could.
I want to see how she's doing.
Getting up to walk around is part of my exercise routine.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: So Dr. Kal'tsit told you the same, eh?

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Ah, that's right. Ever since Medical took in the Manticore girl, everyone's been looking after her.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: I'm glad you've taken my advice to heart, but I'm afraid that just walking around isn't enough.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Oh, but let's talk about the Manticore girl first.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: We medics all want to help her.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Even though her infection has already developed to an intermediate stage, with Rhodes Island's current technology, we can get it under control to prevent further deterioration.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: The data collected from the infection monitoring device shows that the Originium crystals inside her are now quite active, and it doesn't help that she's weak from refusing to eat.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: None of us want to see our patients consume themselves like this.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: But if I was suddenly taken to a strange new environment, and found myself lying on an operating table first thing after waking up, I'd be plenty scared too.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: So, uh, I brought one of Hibiscus's healthy meals with me and planned on saying hi to her first, just as a token of our good will.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Do you have any ideas, Doctor?

options: Tell her Rhodes Island can protect her.
That health food is the opposite of good will.
Tell her Rhodes Island needs her skills.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Protect? Doctor, do you mean to say... She's not just afraid because we're a strange new place?

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Right, maybe she's also scared of her Oripathy. As a medic, I can guarantee that her life won't be in any danger.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Yeah, you have a point, Doctor. Healthy meals primarily incorporate cold foods, which may not sit well with someone who hasn't eaten in days, or be digestible enough to give her energy.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Eh? Doctor, are you saying she can become a reserve operator?

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: To be honest, if I encountered an invisible enemy during a training exercise, I'd be pretty nervous myself, haha...

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Phew. With you here, I always feel like we have a better chance of persuading the other party.

options: Oh right, and try not to be too graphic when describing what we do.
You can share with her why you trust Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Makes sense.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: To be honest, as a reserve operator, I don't actually know what hellish battles you and the regulars have had to endure.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: But so many patients have told me... that you saved them.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Me? I trust in Rhodes Island's determination to find a cure for Oripathy, and I deeply admire Dr. Kal'tsit's knowledge and ability.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: And when I'm tending to the wounded in a dangerous operation, I have full faith that you'll be in firm control of the situation so I don't have to focus on anything but my responsibilities as a medic operator.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: That's probably what I'd tell her.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Doctor, did you want to come along with me?

steps.name: Person in a White Mask
steps.text: How long have you been hiding in here?

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: Eek!

steps.name: Person in a White Mask
steps.text: You're too weak to kill a single beast to even feed yourself anymore?

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: I... I don't want to be like this either... I'm not hiding on purpose. It's just that, nobody can see me...

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: I... have no weapons. I've never touched a weapon...

steps.name: Person in a White Mask
steps.text: You were born a weapon.

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: I've always been very careful... My tail has never hurt anyone!

steps.name: Person in a White Mask
steps.text: Who are you trying to deceive by feigning weakness? You no longer have an audience.

steps.name: Person in a White Mask
steps.text: Your Oripathy has progressed to this stage. Do you still think you can stay in the market as always, earning your next meal from somebody else's hands?

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: H-How do you know... Who are you?

steps.name: Person in a White Mask
steps.text: You should know this well enough. There's no place for you in your old life.

steps.name: Person in a White Mask
steps.text: You must learn to wield a weapon. This is the only worth you now have.

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: No... I won't...

steps.name: Person in a White Mask
steps.text: Look, this is a painkiller for Oripathy.

steps.name: Person in a White Mask
steps.text: You want to live, right?

steps.name: Person in a White Mask
steps.text: My team happens to have a spot for monsters like you.

steps.name: Person in a White Mask
steps.text: Join us. The leader will save you.

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: Ugh...
The familiar pangs of hunger, the sensation of her consciousness withering away due to dehydration.
These things will sometimes happen in this stalking crouch. She is capable of judging her own body's state, and if she's on the job, she won't lose control.
However, every job she's had in the past specified a rendezvous point. As long as she could reach it, she'd have a chance to rest.

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: There's nothing on the note this time...

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: Ah... Even though I'm obviously useless now, I still want to be saved...

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: Even though I already knew... that the leader was lying...

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door
steps.text: Hello...?

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Hello, my name is Ansel.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: I'm sorry, but I don't know what to call you. But here at Rhodes Island, there are a lot of people who don't want to disclose their real names, so they go by codenames. You can choose one for yourself.

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: (They keep talking about this 'Rhodes Island.' Where is Rhodes Island?)

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: (The same thing is written on these clothes...)

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: I completely understand... When you woke up, you found yourself in a strange new place. You must be very nervous. I just want to tell you we don't have any ill will towards you.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Um... I was one of the assistants standing to the side taking notes, so I hope you don't take this the wrong way.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: We are a non-state affiliated pharmaceutical company that hopes to help all Infected people across Terra.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Even though you didn't come to Rhodes Island voluntarily, and were brought here by accident, you were in very poor physical condition at the time, and we examined you as part of our duties as medics.

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: (He referred to this place as a pharmaceutical company... Is it a Columbian company?)

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: We really do want to help you... But if you don't want our help, we won't force you either.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Oh, but, Rhodes Island is well outside Sargon's borders right now.

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: (Outside... Sargon?)

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: If you wanted to go back, we wouldn't be able to let you off the ship until the next time we docked at a nomadic city. After that, you'd have to find your own way back.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Of course, it'd be ideal if you chose to stay with us. Oh, and uh, our medical examination won't intrude on your privacy.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Also, someone should've already introduced you to the Doctor, right?

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: (The Doctor... I keep hearing this title...)

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: The Doctor says your skills will be useful to us.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Because the situations surrounding the Infected can be rather dire, when we try to extend a helping hand to them, we inevitably run into conflicts with other people.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: So, we are in need of partners who are able and willing to fight to protect others.

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: (He said 'need'... Does that mean I can still be useful?)

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Oh, but don't let that scare you. You'll probably just be a reserve operator like me.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: And all the regular operators talk about the Doctor's reliable command.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Plenty of regulars come back from life-or-death situations to tell me the Doctor was the one who saved them.

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: (Really?)

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: (They won't send me to die?)

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: (*Softly clears throat*) ...H-Hello.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Doctor, she doesn't seem to be responding. Do you need to get back to work?

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: No, p-please wait...

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: I can't hear anything from inside. She might still be sleeping.

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: Don't go... I have to prove myself...

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: Commander, please don't leave me...

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: I am worried about her, but I suppose we also shouldn't bother her too much.

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: I'm right here... Please notice me...

steps.name: Panicked Manticore Girl
steps.text: I want to live...

options: The door seems to sway, ever so slightly.
If you don't know how to answer, you can give me a codename first.
What would you like me to call you?
(Pass your notepad and pencil through the door.)

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: You're right, Doctor. For the operators of Rhodes Island, a raid of this sort would not be impossible.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I also agree with putting some less-experienced operators into this drill. So they won't be completely caught off guard when encountering invisible enemies on the battlefield.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: But there is one problem: we don't know anything about this assassin who goes by 'Manticore.'

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: You can't let her scribbles on a single piece of paper replace the formal application process, let alone serve as an application to participate in a combat exercise.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: She still hasn't talked about her past, and the only information we have on her background is still vague.

options: That's exactly why we can trust her.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Are you saying that once we win her over, she'll never betray–– I see now.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: But first, how will Rhodes Island win her over?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: When our operators have the ability to defend against her attacks, or even counter them, this mock battle will instead have the effect of demonstrating Rhodes Island's sincerity to her.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Just like how an assassin places a knife by the monarch's pillow to let the opposition know she has the ability to strike at any time, but simply chooses not to.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: She should be able to get our meaning.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Fine. I accept your proposal.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I'll arrange for a video recording of this exercise, to keep as part of her files.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Doctor, I trust you'll be able to get exactly what we need.
